description: A ground-level photograph depicts a vast, treeless, dry grassland landscape under a clear, cloudless blue sky. The foreground and midground are covered predominantly by short, yellowish-brown, dry grasses, interspersed with a few sparse, low-lying green shrubs. The terrain appears flat and extends to a distant horizon line, where a faint haze blurs the boundary between land and sky. The image conveys an impression of an arid or semi-arid environment. In the bottom left corner, the image is credited with "©Eurostat, 2012. LUCAS".
